 'So close I could taste it': Baker leaves Great British Bake Off before final
 Updated / Tuesday, 17 Nov 2026
 21:25
 Great British Bake Off 
 A Great British Bake Off contestant has said they were "so close I could taste it" after leaving the show ahead of next week's final.
 Spoiler alert: This article contains details of Tuesday’s episode of Great British Bake Off 
 32-year-old drag artist Gabe Capes’ departure means the final of the Channel 4 baking show will be contested between Mo Mahir, Moyin Odeniran and Tom Whittaker.
 Speaking after their departure, Capes said: "Oh my god, so close I could taste it, but it is what it is.
 "I am so proud of myself, I really pushed myself with this, and I feel I have learned a huge amount."
 The semi-final saw contestants take part in Patisserie Week, with Mahir being named star baker.
 Following the conclusion of the episode, judge Paul Hollywood said: "Next week is the final, and I think between Mo, Moyin and Tom, I can’t call it. So next week, game on."
 Speaking about when presenter Alison Hammond told them they had been eliminated, Capes added: "It was horrid, that week really felt like it could have been any of us going, but I was just so hoping it wasn’t going to be me.
 "That night I woke up in a cold sweat having dreamed that I was reliving the moment. I think I will forever be haunted by Alison saying my name."
 They said they had learned to believe in themself on the programme, having applied for the show "on sheer homosexual delusion".
 Capes added: " Bake Off has been one of the most exciting and enjoyable experiences of my life.
 "I’ve had copious amounts of fun, I’ve met some of the most amazing people, and I’ve overcome challenges I didn’t know I was capable of, challenges that have helped me grow as a baker and a person.
 "If you have ever even considered applying for Bake Off , do it."
 The Great British Bake Off final will take place Tuesday, 24 November at 8pm.
 Source: Press Association
